cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected <> '' MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber, cr.clausesAffected, sp.specNumber ORDER BY r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber LIMIT 10
question_en: Trace sections from a resolution through its CR's affected clauses (decision-to-section trace).
